_comment: The game's sound catalog — EXAMPLE content, replace with your own. This file is the source of truth for audio and is meant to be edited by a sound designer without touching TypeScript. Every clip here is SYNTHESIZED (an inline oscillator/noise stack), so the starter ships no audio files and needs no banks: each example shows a different sound-design technique. To add a real recorded sound, put the file in public/assets/sounds/, add an { type: 'audio', bank: '…' } entry to the preload manifest in main.ts, and name the file in an event's clips. Keep the event names in step with src/audio/soundIds.ts — audioSettings.test.ts fails if they drift. Tune the SOUND here; tune the MIX and spatialization in AUDIO (src/config/gameplayConstants.ts). See docs/audio.md.

voiceGroups.description: UI blips share two voices, so a flurry of taps cannot flood the mix

events.name: select
events._comment: UI confirm: a short upward square blip. Single square layer + pitch bend + tight envelope.

events.name: laser
events._comment: Laser 'pew': a fast high-to-low square bend — the downward sweep reads as a shot.

events.name: explosion
events._comment: A bright square flash, a white-noise body, and a low square rumble — multi-layer + noise + low frequencies stacked into one boom.

events.name: pickup
events._comment: A warm major arpeggio — three triangle notes offset by `delay`. Sequenced notes in one clip.

events.name: shield
events._comment: Metallic 'ting': two triangles at the same pitch, one detuned, for a shimmer.

events.name: hit
events._comment: Two slightly different sawtooth ticks, picked at random but never the same twice running, so repeats do not machine-gun. Several clips in one event ARE the variation pool.
